children.name: This is the dashboard page. It displays key in formation to the user. We expect you to implement this page in high-definition (as exact as possible to match the design). Attention to detail is important, and you will be evaluated with that in mind. Because AI makes this part less technical, we expect you to implement this “full-stack.” This means hosting the site, and adding a back end to store data that persists beyond the session. The back end data should reflect he shape of data on the page.  Most importantly, you must conduct research on how to do this and JUSTIFY your decisions. In your final round interview, we will be much more interested in your ability to articulate WHY you did something, not just that you did it!

children.name: This figma contains design elements outlining a UI for “Toph”  Toph is a software platform used by farmers to log the work completed on their farmlands. The most common use case for Toph is to log what fertilizer/chemical is used on what fields.   Farm workers can use a mobile app to record audio recordings hands-free, and Toph will transcribe and record the important information from their log into the platform.   Farmers access the data on a computer through the dashboard page, which is the page shown here in this design! >>  Users can click on rows, which expands to reveal the whole data behind the log. This is shown in the “expanded view” Please implement the Toph dashboard.
